test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: The selling price of an item is 15% more than the cost price and shopkeeper is able to earn ₹25. What is the selling price of the item?
solution:
**Given:**

The selling price of an item is 15% more than the cost price and shopkeeper is able to earn ₹25.

**Formula used:**

Selling Price (SP) = Cost Price (CP) + Profit

Profit = CP × Profit%

**Calculation:**

Let CP be x.

Profit = x × 15% = 0.15x

Given Profit = ₹25

⇒ 0.15x = 25

⇒ x = 25 / 0.15

⇒ x = ₹166.67

Selling Price (SP) = CP + Profit

⇒ SP = 166.67 + 25

⇒ SP = ₹191.67

**∴ The correct answer is option 3.**
